description: Source code implementing WebSocket stream adapters for SPDY and QUIC protocols, including classes for handling socket operations, stream delegation, and data transfer management within the Chromium networking stack.

classes.name: WebSocketClientSocketHandleAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for handling socket read/write and disconnect operations for WebSocket client sockets.

classes.name: WebSocketSpdyStreamAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for managing SPDY stream operations, including reading, writing, and delegate callbacks for WebSocket streams.

classes.name: WebSocketQuicStreamAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for managing QUIC stream operations, including reading, header handling, and delegate callbacks for WebSocket over QUIC.

methods.name: WebSocketClientSocketHandleAdapter::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket into the provided buffer.

methods.name: WebSocketClientSocketHandleAdapter::Write
methods.description: Writes data from the buffer to the socket with traffic annotation.

methods.name: WebSocketSpdyStreamAdapter::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the SPDY stream into the buffer, handling pending state.

methods.name: WebSocketSpdyStreamAdapter::Write
methods.description: Sends data over the SPDY stream.

methods.name: WebSocketSpdyStreamAdapter::Disconnect
methods.description: Detaches delegate and nullifies the stream.

methods.name: WebSocketSpdyStreamAdapter::OnClose
methods.description: Handles stream closure and notifies delegate.

methods.name: WebSocketQuicStreamAdapter::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the QUIC stream, managing pending state.

methods.name: WebSocketQuicStreamAdapter::Write
methods.description: Placeholder for writing data over QUIC stream.

methods.name: WebSocketQuicStreamAdapter::OnInitialHeadersComplete
methods.description: Processes initial headers received over QUIC.

methods.name: WebSocketQuicStreamAdapter::OnBodyAvailable
methods.description: Handles available body data on QUIC stream.

methods.name: WebSocketQuicStreamAdapter::ClearStream
methods.description: Clears the reference to the QUIC stream.
